after_home.name: Me
after_home.text: *I walk through the darkened streets. Streetlights cast long shadows across the road.*

after_home_walk.name: Me
after_home_walk.text: *This neighborhood is starting to feel familiar. Past the alley by the convenience store is home... I remember seeing that vending machine earlier too.*

after_home_neighborhood.name: Me
after_home_neighborhood.text: *A quiet residential area. The smell of dinner wafts over from somewhere. It's an unfamiliar neighborhood, but it feels oddly comfortable.*

after_home_arrive.name: Me
after_home_arrive.text: *At the front door. I fish out my key and unlock it. Looks like my parents aren't home yet.*

after_home_2.name: Me
after_home_2.text: *I flip the light on in my room and flop onto the bed. The unfamiliar ceiling feels strangely cozy tonight — must be the mood.*

after_home_settle.name: Me
after_home_settle.text: *I change out of my uniform into something comfortable. Set down my bag and organize today's handouts on the desk.*

after_home_3.name: Me
after_home_3.text: *What's waiting for me tomorrow? This strange sense of anticipation means sleep probably won't come easy.*

night_reflect_start.name: Me
night_reflect_start.text: *Staring at the ceiling, I replay the day. For a first day... a lot happened.*

night_reflect_seoyeon.name: Me
night_reflect_seoyeon.text: *Seoyeon... acts cool but has an unexpectedly warm side. I keep thinking about the look on her face when she said I was the first person to talk back to her.*

night_reflect_yuna.name: Me
night_reflect_yuna.text: *Yuna... she didn't say much, but those eyes keep coming back to me. What did she mean by 'same light'?*

night_reflect_dain.name: Me
night_reflect_dain.text: *Dain... overflowing with energy. It'd be impossible to be bored around her. She looked pretty impressive on that volleyball court.*

night_reflect_nurse.name: Me
night_reflect_nurse.text: *The school nurse... 'cute transfer student,' she says. That office is becoming a strangely persistent thought.*

night_reflect_teacher.name: Me
night_reflect_teacher.text: *The homeroom teacher is strict on the outside but warm underneath. Glad to have a teacher like that.*

night_reflect_end.name: Me
night_reflect_end.text: *This school... not bad, actually. Wonder what tomorrow will bring.*

night_diary_choice.name: Me
night_diary_choice.text: *I notice a new notebook in the desk drawer. Did Mom sneak it in as a transfer gift?*

night_diary_write_1.name: Me
night_diary_write_1.text: *I pick up a pen and open to the first page. 'Month X, Day X. First day at the new school. Better than expected.'*

night_diary_write_2.name: Me
night_diary_write_2.text: *'Met some interesting people. A cool student council president, an enigmatic literary girl, a volleyball ace with the energy of a small sun...'*

night_diary_write_3.name: Me
night_diary_write_3.text: *'Will I get closer to them tomorrow? Looking forward to it.' ...I set the pen down and close the notebook. Writing it out helped clear my head.*

night_home.name: Me
night_home.text: *Before falling asleep, I check my phone out of habit.*

night_home_check_contact.name: Me
night_home_check_contact.text: *The people I exchanged numbers with today... who should I message first?*
choices: Send a message to the Nurse.
Send a message to the Teacher.
Stop messaging and go to sleep.

day1_check_affinity.name: System
day1_check_affinity.text: Here are your current affinity levels with each character.{affinity_list}

night_message_teacher.name: Me
night_message_teacher.text: *I sent a message to the teacher. 'Teacher, thanks for looking out for me today. I think I adapted well on my first day because of you.'*

night_message_teacher_reply.name: Teacher
night_message_teacher_reply.text: *A quick reply.* 'Oh my, {name}! Sending a message like this on your very first day as a transfer student. How thoughtful.'

night_message_teacher_extra_1.name: Teacher
night_message_teacher_extra_1.text: 'By the way, that look on your face during class today... you were definitely thinking about something else, weren't you? I saw everything~'

night_message_teacher_extra_2.name: Me
night_message_teacher_extra_2.text: *Busted? I typed back: 'It's just... the classroom was so different from my old school, I was fascinated!'*

night_message_teacher_extra_3.name: Teacher
night_message_teacher_extra_3.text: 'Haha, is that so~ Tomorrow is the real start, so take care of yourself and get plenty of rest. See you tomorrow!'

night_message_teacher_extra_4.name: Me
night_message_teacher_extra_4.text: *Strict on the outside, but this attentive underneath. Glad to have a teacher like her.*

night_message_seyoun_lunch.name: Me
night_message_seyoun_lunch.text: *I sent a message to Seoyeon. 'That rooftop lunchbox today was seriously good. Thanks, Seoyeon.'*

night_message_seyoun_after.name: Me
night_message_seyoun_after.text: *I sent a message to Seoyeon. 'I'm glad I could help with student council work today. Don't overdo it. See you tomorrow.'*

night_message_seyoun_generic.name: Me
night_message_seyoun_generic.text: *I sent a message to Seoyeon. 'Thanks for looking after me on day one. See you at school tomorrow.'*

night_message_seyoun_reply_lunch.name: Seoyeon
night_message_seyoun_reply_lunch.text: *Instant reply.* 'You liked it? Good! Look forward to tomorrow too. The menu is a secret.'

night_message_seyoun_reply_standard.name: Seoyeon
night_message_seyoun_reply_standard.text: *Instant reply.* 'I had a good time too. You adapt fast for a transfer student. See you at school tomorrow.'

night_message_seyoun_reply_high.name: Seoyeon
night_message_seyoun_reply_high.text: *A reply with a heart emoji.* 'Hey... today was really fun. Want me to pack another lunchbox tomorrow? Tell me if there's anything you want to eat lol'

night_message_seyoun_reply_low.name: Seoyeon
night_message_seyoun_reply_low.text: *A short reply that arrived much later.* 'Yeah. See you tomorrow.'

night_message_seyoun_followup.name: Me
night_message_seyoun_followup.text: *I stared at Seoyeon's reply for a while. I want to say something more...*
choices: Send 'What do you want to eat tomorrow?'

night_message_seyoun_followup_food.name: Seoyeon
night_message_seyoun_followup_food.text: *Instant reply.* 'Already thinking about tomorrow's lunch? That's kind of cute lol. Maybe I'll pack a surprise lunchbox? Go to sleep excited.'

night_message_seyoun_followup_goodnight.name: Seoyeon
night_message_seyoun_followup_goodnight.text: *A reply after a moment.* '...Good night, {name}. Sweet dreams.'

night_message_seyoun_followup_end.name: Me
night_message_seyoun_followup_end.text: *I can't believe how natural it feels talking with Seoyeon. Getting this close on day one...*

night_message_yuna.name: Me
night_message_yuna.text: *I sent a message to Yuna. 'Had a nice time today. Sleep well.'*

night_message_yuna_reply_standard.name: Yuna
night_message_yuna_reply_standard.text: *A reply arrived much later.* '...Yeah. You too.'

night_message_yuna_reply_high.name: Yuna
night_message_yuna_reply_high.text: *A reply arrived much later.* 'Today... thanks. I think I was able to smile a little because of you.'

night_message_yuna_reply_low.name: Yuna
night_message_yuna_reply_low.text: *No reply. Only the read receipt is showing.*

night_message_yuna_cryptic.name: Yuna
night_message_yuna_cryptic.text: *Another message.* '...{name}. If you can see the stars tonight, look at the third one. I'll tell you why later.'

night_message_yuna_cryptic_react.name: Me
night_message_yuna_cryptic_react.text: *The third star? What does that mean. That's so Yuna, I guess.*

night_message_yuna_cryptic_choice.name: Me
choices: Send 'Got it, I'll make sure to look.'

night_message_yuna_cryptic_reply.name: Me
night_message_yuna_cryptic_reply.text: *I replied 'Got it. I'll make sure to look.' ...I actually glance out the window, and there are a few stars out. The third one is... that one?*

night_message_yuna_cryptic_ask.name: Yuna
night_message_yuna_cryptic_ask.text: *Reply.* '...Telling you now would ruin the point. Just look.'

night_message_yuna_cryptic_end.name: Yuna
night_message_yuna_cryptic_end.text: *One last reply.* '...Did you see it? Then that's enough. You'll have good dreams. Probably.'

night_message_dain_date.name: Me
night_message_dain_date.text: *I sent a message to Dain. 'That tteokbokki today was seriously amazing! Let's go again sometime haha'*

night_message_dain_generic.name: Me
night_message_dain_generic.text: *I sent a message to Dain. 'You looked awesome at practice today! See you tomorrow.'*

night_message_dain_reply_date.name: Dain
night_message_dain_reply_date.text: *Instant reply.* 'Right?! I know all the best spots! Next time we're adding sundae too!!'

night_message_dain_reply_standard.name: Dain
night_message_dain_reply_standard.text: *Instant reply.* 'Oh~ you saw? So embarrassing! lol I'll show you something even cooler tomorrow! Night, {name}!!'

night_message_dain_reply_high.name: Dain
night_message_dain_reply_high.text: *Instant reply.* 'Ooh you saw?! My serve receive was perfect today right lol. Tomorrow I'm showing you my spike!! Get hyped!!'

night_message_dain_selfie.name: Dain
night_message_dain_selfie.text: *A photo arrived. A selfie from the gym, flashing a peace sign.* 'Today's me! Pretty cool right? lol'

night_message_dain_selfie_react.name: Me
night_message_dain_selfie_react.text: *Dain's selfie... her energy practically leaps off the screen. I couldn't help but smile.*

night_message_dain_challenge.name: Dain
night_message_dain_challenge.text: *Another message.* 'Oh right! How about a race up the hill behind school tomorrow morning?! Loser buys snacks! You in?!'

night_message_dain_challenge_choice.name: Me
night_message_dain_challenge_choice.text: *A challenge from Dain. What should I do?*
choices: Send 'What are you gonna do when YOU lose? lol'

night_message_dain_challenge_accept.name: Dain
night_message_dain_challenge_accept.text: *Instant reply.* 'That's the attitude!! You gotta show up early tomorrow okay?! Oversleep and it's a forfeit!! Night, let's gooo!!!'

night_message_dain_challenge_tease.name: Dain
night_message_dain_challenge_tease.text: *Instant reply.* 'What?! lol Big talk!! Fine, we'll see about that!! Meet at the front gate tomorrow morning!! Night!!!'

night_message_nurse.name: Me
night_message_nurse.text: *I sent a message to the nurse. 'Thank you for today. I was able to relax and rest.'*

night_message_nurse_reply_standard.name: Nurse
night_message_nurse_reply_standard.text: *A reply.* 'Oh my, you actually texted? What a sweet kid~ My cute transfer student~'

night_message_nurse_reply_high.name: Nurse
night_message_nurse_reply_high.text: *A reply.* 'Oh my~ A message like this at night — are you trying to keep me awake? Just kidding~ I do like that sweet side of you though.'

night_message_nurse_extra_1.name: Nurse
night_message_nurse_extra_1.text: 'By the way, aren't you worn out from adjusting to the new school? Don't push yourself~ If you get a headache, come straight to the nurse's office.'

night_message_nurse_extra_2.name: Me
night_message_nurse_extra_2.text: *I replied 'Thank you! Please get some rest too.' ...It's really nice how she quietly looks out for me.*

night_message_nurse_extra_3.name: Nurse
night_message_nurse_extra_3.text: 'Thanks~ Sleep well, {name}. I'll wish you sweet dreams~'

night_message_nurse_extra_4.name: Me
night_message_nurse_extra_4.text: *'I'll wish you sweet dreams' — that line sticks in my mind. She's a teacher, but... why does it keep nagging at me.*

night_goodnight_start.name: Me
night_goodnight_start.text: *I put my phone down and sit up in bed. Maybe I'll open the window for a moment before I sleep.*

night_goodnight_window.name: Me
night_goodnight_window.text: *I open the window and a cool night breeze brushes my face. A few stars are scattered across the sky. Way more visible here than in the city.*

night_goodnight_sounds.name: Me
night_goodnight_sounds.text: *Crickets chirping. A faint train whistle in the distance. This quiet night isn't half bad.*

night_goodnight_think.name: Me
night_goodnight_think.text: *What's waiting for me tomorrow, I wonder.*

night_goodnight_close.name: Me
night_goodnight_close.text: *I close the window and crawl under the covers. Close my eyes and sleep should come.*

night_surprise_check.name: Me
night_surprise_check.text: *Just as I'm about to close my eyes — ding! A phone notification. Who at this hour?*

night_surprise_seyoun.name: Seoyeon
night_surprise_seyoun.text: *A message from Seoyeon.* 'I can't sleep so... want to meet at the front gate tomorrow and walk to school together?'

night_surprise_seyoun_react.name: Me
night_surprise_seyoun_react.text: *I replied 'Sounds good. Front gate tomorrow.' ...Seoyeon reaching out first. The corner of my mouth curls up.*

night_surprise_yuna.name: Yuna
night_surprise_yuna.text: *A message from Yuna.* '...Still awake? The stars are pretty tonight. That's all.'

night_surprise_yuna_react.name: Me
night_surprise_yuna_react.text: *I replied 'I was just looking at the stars too.' ...The thought that we're under the same sky lands in a strange way.*

night_surprise_dain.name: Dain
night_surprise_dain.text: *A message from Dain.* 'You're still up right?! Don't forget about tomorrow's race!! You should probably stretch lol. Night!!'

night_surprise_dain_react.name: Me
night_surprise_dain_react.text: *I replied 'Don't worry, I'm ready.' Dain's energy is the same at night as it is during the day.*

night_surprise_nurse.name: Nurse
night_surprise_nurse.text: *A message from the nurse.* 'If you're still up, that's a problem~ Want me to give you a sleep consultation at the nurse's office tomorrow? Kidding~ Good night, cute transfer student.'

night_surprise_nurse_react.name: Me
night_surprise_nurse_react.text: *I replied 'I'm going to sleep now! Thank you.' ...Playful as ever, but she really is looking out for me, isn't she.*

night_surprise_teacher.name: Teacher
night_surprise_teacher.text: *A message from the teacher.* 'Are you still up? Wanted to give you a heads-up — 3rd period tomorrow got changed to PE. Good night!'

night_surprise_teacher_react.name: Me
night_surprise_teacher_react.text: *I replied 'Thank you, Teacher! Good night.' ...Thoughtful enough to reach out about something like this.*

night_surprise_react.name: Me
night_surprise_react.text: *Caught me off guard, but it put a smile on my face. I flip my phone face-down and pull up the covers. Today was a genuinely good day.*

day1_end.name: Me
day1_end.text: *New encounters, unfamiliar feelings... the first day at the new school ends like this. What kind of day will tomorrow be?*
